body.name: \(\mathcal R_n^{\mathrm{ret}}\)
body.def: Construct \(\mathcal R_n^{\mathrm{ret}}\) explicitly from \(\widehat w_n\): for coordinate \(j\), retain only the release mask if \(\widehat w_{n,j}>a_n\), only the binding mask if \(\widehat w_{n,j}<-a_n\), and both masks otherwise; for the gap and survivor-minimum comparisons retain both signs when the absolute difference of their affine inputs is at most \(a_n\), and otherwise retain the empirical sign; retain every lower zero or cut branch within \(a_n\) of the empirical maximum and every upper cut or mass-cap branch within \(a_n\) of the empirical minimum. The retained set consists of every compatible Cartesian combination of these choices.
